title: Assistant-Guided Mitigation of Teacher Preference Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fine-tuned proxy judge models on pairwise ranking datasets (e.g., OffsetBias, MT-Bench Human Judge) to measure their disproportionate preference for responses generated by their teacher model (e.g., GPT-4) compared to ground-truth human labels or objectively better responses from other models.

Analyzing the teacher model's (GPT-4) training data and evaluations to demonstrate its tendency to favor its own outputs based on stylistic features (e.g., informativeness, citations, depth of reasoning) rather than core evaluation criteria.
